blurb: BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse offers a variety of food and drink options including shareable appetizers, pizzas, burgers, soups, salads, and slow-roasted favorites. They have 11 award-winning signature beers and cider on tap, plus rotating seasonal beers. The restaurant is suitable for small parties to large family and social gatherings, with patios and a heated cocktail patio with firepit.
